identificationModule.briefTitle: An Open-label Phase 3 Study of Lutetium (177Lu) Oxodotreotide Injection in Subjects With Advanced Gastrointestinal Pancreatic Neuroendocrine Tumors.
identificationModule.officialTitle: Randomized, Open, Positive Control Phase III Clinical Trial of Lutetium (177Lu) Oxodotreotide Injection Combined With Standard-dose Long-acting Octreotide Versus High-dose Long-acting Octreotide in the Treatment of Somatostatin Receptor-positive Advanced Gastrointestinal Pancreatic Neuroendocrine Tumors.

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The study is being conducted to evaluate the efficacy, and safety of Lutetium (177Lu) Oxodotreotide Injection in subjects with advanced gastrointestinal pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors.

interventions.name: Lutetium (177Lu) Oxodotreotide Injection；long-acting Octreotide
interventions.description: Lutetium (177Lu) Oxodotreotide Injection combined with standard-dose long-acting Octreotide.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Incidence and severity of adverse event (AE) and serious adverse event (SAE)
